reason: I've had a cough and sore throat for two days.
diagnosis: Likely viral upper respiratory infection, with COVID-19 needing exclusion because of dry cough, sore throat, runny nose, myalgias, and hospital workplace exposure.
keyPoints: Onset and progression of sore throat, dry cough, and runny nose
COVID exposure risk, especially hospital work and sick contacts
Presence of red flags: fever, shortness of breath, chest pain, hemoptysis
Associated viral symptoms: myalgias, fatigue, headache, nausea/vomiting
Severity of throat symptoms, dysphagia, hoarseness, and ability to swallow
